Mr21 - image converter

Convert images to PNG, JPEG or WebP in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.

Works offline
or drop files and folders here, or paste with Ctrl+V No files yet JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF, RAW (DNG, CR2, NEF, ARW, RW2), PNM, XPM, XBM
Output format
92

    PNG is lossless and keeps transparency. JPEG and WebP are smaller; JPEG turns transparent areas white.

    RAW files use the full-size JPEG the camera stores inside the file when there is one; otherwise the sensor data is developed with dcraw (can take a while for large files).

    Enter
    Convert
    Esc
    Cancel conversion, or clear the list (undoable)
    Ctrl+V
    Paste images or screenshots
